instructions.name: pool_rescale_virtual_balances
docs: v6.1 (T22): price-neutral repair of a pool that violates the strict
slot, e.g. a migrated legacy pool at `V == A`): multiply every
prices are unchanged; depth / leverage grows. Works on a frozen pool
so the repair can precede the unfreeze.
`treasury.admin` ONLY (raising a pool's leverage is a governance
judgement with reserve-depletion exposure; never the supervisor).

instructions.name: pool_set_hook_disabled
docs: Flip a pool's native-hook emergency switch (v6.1, T9), signing
pool stops CPI'ing its hook (swaps / deposits go on with the base fee,
or pause on a `PAUSE_WHEN_DISABLED` pool; removes always work);
`false` re-arms it. Instant — a security action outside any cooldown.
Fails with `coffer_pool::HookInvalidConfig` on a pool without a hook.
`treasury.admin` ONLY (re-arming a hook is a governance judgement, so
the supervisor does not get the one-directional circuit-breaker rule).

fields.name: supervisor
docs: Limited circuit-breaker pubkey. Allowed to call ONLY
(v6.1 T3) `cancel_action`: it may restrict, never relax
(`crate::authority`). Cannot transfer itself, has no claim flow —
admin sets it via `set_supervisor` (D-class since T3).
`Pubkey::default()` ⇒ no supervisor; only admin can freeze.
Added in v2; reads as `Pubkey::default()` on migrated v1 accounts.
